title: Jan Jan H Hanım ve Sıradışı Buluşlar
author: Mine Pöge
description: Meet the delightfully eccentric Ms. Jingle Jangle H, founder of the Institute for Ridiculous Research and Remarkably Impossible Things. Her mind is sharp as scissors, yet she doesn’t use her cleverness to cut things apart. Whenever a curious problem appears, before anyone even knows what to call it, she arrives with unusual inventions, unexpected questions, and wonderfully unconventional solutions. Across four whimsical chapters, she investigates hurt feelings, challenges a nationwide ban on mistakes, explores the Museum of Mistakes, and helps people see themselves and one another in entirely new ways.
original_title: Jan Jan H Hanım ve Sıradışı Buluşlar
english_title: Ms Jingle Jangle H and the Extraordinary Inventions: Life Gets Better When It Gets Messy
